title: Flipper's Retreat | KEY.co
description_expanded: Tucked into a serene coastal community, this two-story beach cottage is an idyllic retreat for both relaxation and adventure. With its calming palette of coastal blues and soothing neutrals, the living area beckons families and friends to unwind in comfort after sun-drenched days. Mornings are a delight in the spacious kitchen, where bright white cabinetry and gleaming stainless steel appliances invite culinary exploration. A generous kitchen bar and dining space become the heart of the home, perfect for leisurely brunches or animated evening feasts. Outdoors, the private back patio sets the stage for al fresco enjoyment with its inviting seating and BBQ grill, while the large community pool just a whisper away offers a refreshing dip under the sun. The included six-seater golf cart becomes your chariot to nearby white sandy shores, making beach jaunts an effortless part of daily life. This home is not just a stay but a foray into a laid-back lifestyle, where every detail caters to creating unforgettable memories under the wide, azure sky.
